tests.source_id: Pang BY et al., Ann Med 2023, PMID:36476015
tests.notes: Meta-analysis of 83 studies (n=9546). AFP alone: sensitivity 61%, specificity 87%, AUC=0.78. Combined with AFP-L3+DCP raises AUC to 0.91.
CEA for early breast cancer: <20% sensitivity. Metastatic: 30-50%. Using early-stage value for primary screening context. CA15-3 is preferred primary marker.

tests.source_id: Shi HZ et al., Respirology 2008; Cheng C et al., Expert Rev Respir Med 2022
tests.notes: CEA for lung adenocarcinoma (serum): sensitivity 54%, specificity 94%, DOR=22.5 (Shi 2008). Pleural effusion context higher at DOR=47.26. Using serum values for general screening context.

tests.source_id: Evidence_20260527.md sec 1.5; Kumar Y et al., Eur J Gastroenterol Hepatol 2007
tests.notes: CA19-9 for gastric cancer: sensitivity 20-40%. CA72-4 is preferred gastric marker (sensitivity 20-40%, specificity > CEA).

tests.source_id: Evidence_20260527.md sec 1.4; Pin-Vieito N et al., World J Gastroenterol 2021
tests.notes: CA19-9 for CRC: sensitivity range 20-40%. FIT is preferred CRC screening tool. CA19-9 used as supplementary indicator.

tests.source_id: Evidence_20260527.md sec 1.7; Ghose et al., Ther Adv Med Oncol 2024
tests.notes: CA19-9 is a secondary/supplementary marker for ovarian cancer. CA125 (+HE4 ROMA index) is primary. CA19-9 alone has limited specificity.

tests.source_id: Ben-Ami R et al., Gut 2024, PMID:38123998
tests.notes: CA19-9 in early pancreatic cancer: AUC=0.82 (95%CI 0.72-0.92) in validation set. Sensitivity range 70-80%, specificity 80-90% across train/test/validation cohorts. Not recommended for general population screening.

tests.notes: CA15-3 for early-stage breast cancer: sensitivity <20%. Metastatic: 50-70%. Downgraded from 0.35 to 0.20 to reflect early-screening context. High sensitivity in metastatic monitoring is not applicable for primary screening.

tests.source_id: Huang L et al., Oncotarget 2017, PMID:28969076
tests.notes: Meta-analysis: sensitivity 68.8%, specificity 92.1%, DOR=25.83 (95%CI 17.49-38.14). Primarily a marker for small-cell lung cancer (SCLC). Asian subgroup: sensitivity 59.0%, specificity 90.1%.

tests.notes: ProGRP for SCLC: sensitivity 64%, specificity 94%, DOR=40.98 (95%CI 27.77-60.64). Combined ProGRP+NSE: sensitivity 88.9%, specificity 72.82%. Highest performance among SCLC markers.

tests.source_id: Yu et al., Int J Cancer 2018; ASCCP Guidelines 2019
tests.notes: HPV DNA primary screening: sensitivity >95%, specificity ~85%. HPV-16/18 genotyping accounts for ~80% of cervical cancers. Combined with p16/Ki-67 dual stain for triage of non-16/18 high-risk types.
